cells.title: Make read-only herded runs read-only
cells.action: Per D2 as revised (store 168b8037). (1) `bee herding run` accepts `--read-only`; it lands in Options and job.json as `read_only: true`. (2) prepare.rs: the herding arm that builds `.bee/bin/bee herding run --task-file - --json` appends ` --read-only` for kinds gather and advisor; never for cell or reviewer. (3) Paseo spawn (run.rs `execute_paseo`): a read-only run on provider pi adds env `BEE_HERDING_READ_ONLY=1` (beside BEE_HERDING_WORKER and BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID); any other provider refuses before spawn with a FIX line naming pi as the supported read-only Paseo provider. No `--mode` is set. Herdr and tmux runs only record read_only. (4) worker_guard.rs, when BEE_HERDING_READ_ONLY and BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID are set: file-writing tools (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, and the pi write and edit tools as named in tool-map.ts) are allowed only when the target path resolves inside `.bee/mailbox/<BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID>/`; every other target is denied. cells.title: Add bee herding notify mid-flight messages
cells.action: Per D1 and its refinement. (1) New verb `bee herding notify --kind <question|blocked|dependency|progress|reopen> --text <text> [--correlation-id <id>] [--json]` in herding/notify.rs, registered in the herding.rs match table, in generated/registry_payload.json (same shape as `bee herding steer`), and asserted in the catalog.rs test. It refuses unless BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID is set, and appends one newline-terminated JSON line {job_id, cell_id (from job.json), kind, text, correlation_id, at} to `.bee/mailbox/<that job>/messages.jsonl`, resolving the main root as other herding verbs do. It never calls paseo. (2) herding.rs status: each job gains `messages` (total lines), `unread_messages` (lines past the byte offset stored in the job's `messages.cursor`, counting only newline-terminated lines; absent cursor = 0) and `last_message` (kind and text). (3) mailbox.rs `render_brief`: change `Never run any \`bee\` command.` to name `bee herding notify` as the one exception, and add at most three lines saying the worker may run it while it works, that it never ends the turn, and that a question it must stop for still goes in the result; update the existing test that asserts the never-run wording. (4) result-inbox.ts: add `sendLeaderMessageOutcome` returning "steer" | "turn" | "skipped", and make `sendLeaderMessage` wrap it with its current boolean meaning unchanged. In `drainResultInbox`, for each tracked job (inbox-session jobs only), read messages.jsonl past messages.cursor (newline-terminated lines only), render each through `headerValue` inside a fixed `bee-message` fence carrying job, cell, kind, correlation id, the same data-not-instructions note results carry, and the action line `the worker keeps working; its answer comes in its result; redirect with bee herding steer --job <id>`, send with `sendLeaderMessageOutcome`, and advance messages.cursor only on steer or turn. The message pass runs even when the job has no result yet, and does not change the result-claim rename or the one-result-per-tick return. Tests: verb refusal without the env, append shape, unknown kind refusal, status counts with and without a cursor, brief exception present; a node-run drain test in pi_plugin_contracts.rs that a new line is delivered once, a skipped send is retried on the next tick, and the injected text sits inside the fence.

cells.action: Per D8, add an integration test file with tests named paseo_live_* and marked #[ignore].
